cards.name: CASSC Office
cards.about: The CASSC Office serves as the coordination and administrative space for the student councils under the College of Arts, Sciences, and Social Sciences. It provides a venue for student leaders to organize activities, discuss student concerns, plan college programs, and coordinate with the college administration and other student organizations.
services: Student council coordination and administrative assistance
Planning and organization of college activities and events
Student leadership and council-related concerns
Coordination of student programs and initiatives
Meetings and discussions among student council officers
Assistance with student concerns and suggestions
Communication and coordination with the college administration
schedule: Saturday: Subject to student council activities and meetings

cards.name: OSAD (Office of Student Affairs and Development)
cards.about: The office that handles student affairs and student development at Notre Dame of Marbel University. It supports student organizations and the co-curricular and extra-curricular activities that help students grow as leaders and as members of the university community.
services: Student affairs and development programs
Support for student organizations and their activities
Co-curricular and extra-curricular activities
Student leadership development

cards.name: Records Section
cards.about: An administrative office responsible for maintaining, organizing, and managing official university records and student academic documents. It assists students, faculty, alumni, and other authorized individuals with requests for records and related services.
services: Request and release of academic records
Issuance of transcripts of records (TOR)
Issuance of certificates of enrollment and graduation
Verification of student academic records
Processing of student record requests
Updating and maintaining student records
Assistance with document authentication and certification
Retrieval and safekeeping of official university records

cards.name: Gate 01 (Main Gate)
cards.about: The primary entrance and exit of the NDMU Main Campus along Alunan Avenue. It provides access for students, employees, visitors, and guests and is monitored by university security.
services: Main pedestrian entrance and exit
Primary access for students, personnel, and visitors
Campus security and identification checks
Visitor assistance and entry monitoring
Convenient access from Alunan Avenue
schedule: Holidays: Subject to university security arrangements

cards.name: Bro. Renato B. Cruz Hall
cards.about: Brother Renato Cruz (BRC) is a learning and academic facility of Notre Dame of Marbel University.
